## Reproduction

The engine is deterministic, so a bug reproduces exactly from
the right inputs. Please include as many of these as apply:

- The `--seed` value (or the SIM_SEED in force) and the seed
  line the run printed
- The command stream or WAL file that triggers it, or the
  smallest one you can build
- The crate and version, or the commit SHA
- The full error message or event output, if any
